primary_source.name: Argo GDAC core-profile index and profile NetCDF
primary_source.attribution: International Argo Program and contributing national programs; Argo GDAC DOI 10.17882/42182; CC BY 4.0
primary_source.snapshot_method: hash source index and each successfully downloaded profile file; do not assume upstream immutable

selection.kind: D-core profiles from official index; one profile per WMO platform; deterministic hash ordering; max 100 profiles
selection.limit_request_failures: up to 150 candidates and 25min max CI; refuse to claim training without minimum data
selection.bias_warning: Deliberately D-only WMO-selection is a limited convenience sample, not an exhaustive Southern Ocean atlas

quality.under_ice_position_qc_8: record count, exclude from geographically precise modeling; not a rejection of physical temperature data
quality.raw_qc: store rejected counts and exact per-file SHA256

test.float_holdout: WMO-disjoint 25% of usable profiles by deterministic hash
test.baseline: training-only mean at each chosen pressure level
test.model: fixed ridge features pressure, latitude, longitude, seasonal phase and linear interactions; alpha=10

future_lanes.requirement: Sprof index, PARAMETER_DATA_MODE and BGC QC incl adjusted errors
position uncertainty and withheld trajectory/ice satellite geolocation bridge

protocol_correction.reason: originally pointed to nonexistent argo_profile_index.txt, updated to documented official GDAC ar_index_global_prof.txt; other prereg criteria unchanged

evidence_contract: When actual data and metrics are confirmed, write new append-only JSON evidence, not overwrite this preregistration.
